task: Depo (BranchOffice) Yönetimi — Tam CRUD + Stok Devri + Marketplace Etkisi
description: Depo yönetimi için kapsamlı bir sistem.
notes: CRUD UI (10 dosya), soft delete (5 kontrol), TransferStockAsync (atomic transaction), 5-tab detay, transfer/silme dialog'ları, 10 yeni test, 1477 toplam test pass.
manual_test_steps: Yeni depo ekle, listede göründüğünü doğrula
Depo adını güncelle, değişikliğin yansıdığını doğrula
Stoklu bir depoyu silmeye çalış — stok devri seçeneklerinin sunulduğunu doğrula
Stokları başka depoya transfer et, her iki depodaki stokların doğru güncellendiğini doğrula
StockMovement tablosunda transfer kayıtlarının oluştuğunu doğrula
Marketplace'e bağlı depoyu silmeye çalış — marketplace etkisi uyarısının gösterildiğini doğrula

Marketplace stok miktarlarının silme sonrası yeniden hesaplandığını doğrula (StockPriceChangedEvent)
IsDefaultMarketPlaceStock olan depo silinirken yeni default seçimi istediğini doğrula

description: Mevcut ~130 marketplace servisini (TrendyolProductService, TrendyolOrderService, HepsiburadaProductService vb.) tek bir IMarketplaceAdapter interface'i altında birleştir. Her marketplace tek bir adapter class implement edecek (TrendyolAdapter, HepsiburadaAdapter, N11Adapter vb.). Background polling servisleri de generic hale gelecek — 10 ayrı polling servisi yerine tek MarketplaceBatchPollingService. Strategy + Factory pattern kullanılacak. Yeni marketplace eklemek = tek bir class implement etmek olacak. Mevcut marketplace'leri kademeli olarak migrate et, yeni marketplace'ler direkt adapter pattern ile yazılsın.

Mevcut custom ITenantContext + TenantRegistryService + TenantAwarePollingService altyapısını Finbuckle.MultiTenant kütüphanesiyle değiştir. Subdomain resolution, per-tenant connection string, EF Core integration hazır geliyor. Finbuckle'ın TenantInfo modeli, per-tenant store (EF Core veya config-based), ve middleware pipeline'ını entegre et. Mevcut TenantDbContextFactory ve HttpTenantContext custom kodlarını Finbuckle built-in mekanizmalarıyla değiştir. Background servisler için tenant iteration pattern'ını Finbuckle ile uyumlu hale getir.

Mevcut 5 docker-compose dosyasını (docker-compose.yml, override, prod, stage, monitoring) .NET Aspire AppHost ile değiştir. PostgreSQL, Redis, MinIO, RabbitMQ (gelecekte) tüm altyapı C# ile tanımlanacak. Dev ortamında tek F5 ile her şey ayağa kalkacak. Service discovery otomatik olacak. Health check'ler built-in gelecek. Aspire Dashboard ile traces, metrics, logs tek yerde görünecek. docker-compose dosyaları production deployment için kalabilir ama dev deneyimi Aspire'a taşınacak.

ApplicationDependencyExtension.cs'deki 450+ satırlık manual DI kaydını Scrutor convention-based assembly scanning ile değiştir. IXxxManager → XxxManager pattern'i otomatik taranacak. Marketplace servisleri, event channel'lar, validator'lar da convention ile kaydedilecek. Özel durumlar (conditional mock registration, singleton token cache'ler) için Scrutor decorator/filter mekanizması kullanılacak. Manual kayıt sadece istisnai durumlar için kalacak.
notes: 76 manuel kayıt Scrutor scan ile değiştirildi, 26 DI safety-net test eklendi, IExcelParser/ICsvParser/IProductImportValidator interface'leri oluşturuldu

description: Her marketplace API'si için WireMock.Net ile contract test altyapısı kur. Trendyol, Hepsiburada, N11 (SOAP), Amazon, Pazarama, PttAVM, Ciceksepeti API response'larını stub'la. Mevcut Mock implementasyonları (MockTrendyolOrderService vb.) yerine WireMock HTTP-level mock kullan — bu sayede API client kodunun kendisi de test edilmiş olur. Her marketplace için happy path + error scenario + rate limit / timeout senaryoları. CI/CD pipeline'da external dependency olmadan marketplace testleri çalışabilecek.

Mapster reflection-based mapping'den Mapperly source-generator-based mapping'e geçiş yap. Mapperly compile-time'da mapping kodu üretir — zero runtime reflection, daha iyi performans, compile-time type safety. Business/MapperProfiles/MappingConfig.cs'deki Mapster profilleri Mapperly [Mapper] attribute'lu partial class'lara dönüştürülecek. Tüm .Adapt<T>() çağrıları Mapperly mapper method çağrılarına migrate edilecek. Kademeli geçiş yapılabilir — yeni mapping'ler Mapperly, eskiler zamanla migrate.
notes: 12 Mapperly mapper, Mapster tamamen kaldırıldı, Mapperly 4.x, 1455 test pass

description: Mevcut custom HashingHelper (PBKDF2) + manual user/role/claim yönetimini ASP.NET Identity ile değiştir. UserManager<T>, RoleManager<T>, SignInManager<T> built-in gelecek. Password hashing (Argon2/PBKDF2 otomatik), account lockout, email confirmation, 2FA (mevcut TOTP entegrasyonu korunacak), password reset token'ları Identity ile yönetilecek. Mevcut ApplicationUser entity Identity'nin IdentityUser'ından türeyecek. Migration sırasında mevcut password hash'leri IPasswordHasher custom implementation ile backward-compatible tutulacak.

Mevcut Serilog → Grafana Loki logging stack'ini OpenTelemetry ile değiştir. Traces (marketplace API çağrıları, DB query'leri), Metrics (request latency, marketplace sync duration, queue depth), Logs (structured) tek OpenTelemetry SDK ile toplanacak. Aspire Dashboard dev ortamında traces+metrics+logs görüntüleyecek. Production'da OTLP exporter ile Grafana Tempo (traces) + Prometheus (metrics) + Loki (logs) kullanılabilir. Özellikle marketplace API call tracing kritik — her batch upload'un tam lifecycle'ı trace edilebilir olacak.

description: We need to make sure that category adding process works correctly from end to end. This means that we need to test the entire process of adding a category, from the user interface to the database and back. We should create an e2e test that simulates a user adding a category through the UI, and then verifies that the category is correctly added to the database and displayed in the UI. This will help us ensure that the category adding process is working as expected and that there are no issues or bugs that could affect the user experience. also after that user should sync his category with any open marketplace. So we need to test the syncing process as well. This will help us ensure that the syncing process is working correctly and that categories are being properly synced with the marketplaces.

We need to make sure that product adding process works correctly from end to end. This means that we need to test the entire process of adding a product, from the user interface to the database and back. We should create an e2e test that simulates a user adding a product through the UI, and then verifies that the product is correctly added to the database and displayed in the UI. This will help us ensure that the product adding process is working as expected and that there are no issues or bugs that could affect the user experience. also after that user should sync his product with any open marketplace. So we need to test the syncing process as well. This will help us ensure that the syncing process is working correctly and that products are being properly synced with the marketplaces.
Everytime we refresh the page, the user gets logged out. We need to fix this issue to ensure a better user experience.
notes: Root cause: @attribute [Authorize] in root _Imports.razor applied to App.razor, causing HTTP-level 302 redirect before Blazor starts. Fix: moved [Authorize] from root _Imports.razor to Features/_Imports.razor so only page components are protected, not the App shell. AuthorizeRouteView + RedirectToLogin still enforces auth at Blazor level.
manual_test_steps: Log in to the application with valid credentials.
Observe whether the user remains logged in or gets logged out.

We need to set up a local development environment that allows us to test the project without relying on external services. It seems for local developments it is safe for now howevery for these external marketplaces, they never trigger the webhooks or send a order in our system. So testing orders would be a problem. We need to find a way to simulate these interactions in our local environment.
notes: Arastirma sonucu: Proje zaten kapsamli bir mock altyapisina sahip. Tum marketplace'ler icin UseMock konfigurasyonu mevcut (varsayilan true): Trendyol:UseMock, Hepsiburada:UseMock, N11:UseMock, Pazarama:UseMock, Amazon:UseMock, Ciceksepeti:UseMock, Pttavm:UseMock, Temu:UseMock, EInvoice:UseMock. Her marketplace icin MockXxxOrderService, MockXxxProductService gibi mock implementasyonlar var. DI'da ApplicationDependencyExtension.cs icinde configuration'a gore otomatik swap yapiliyor. Integration testleri Testcontainers+Respawn ile calisiyor. Trendyol webhook endpoint'i /api/trendyol/webhook'ta mevcut. Background servisler TenantAwarePollingService base class kullanarak multi-tenant polling yapiyor. Ek gelistirme: Webhook test endpointleri (diger marketplace'ler icin) ve mock order data zenginlestirme ileride yapilab ilir.

description: Now we have import and export functionality but it seems a little bit buggy. An excel file can not have any row more 1million rows, but we have some files that have more than 1 million rows. We need to find a way to handle these large files without causing performance issues or crashes. We can consider implementing a streaming approach to process the files in smaller chunks, or we can explore using a different file format that supports larger datasets. Additionally, we should also implement error handling to manage any issues that may arise during the import/export process. This will help us ensure that the functionality is robust and can handle a variety of scenarios without causing disruptions to the user experience. Also you need to add date range for the export queries. This will allow users to export data for specific time periods, which can help reduce the size of the exported files and improve performance. We should also consider adding a progress indicator for the import/export process, especially for larger files. This will provide users with feedback on the status of their import/export and help manage expectations regarding the time it may take to complete the process. User should also be able to cancel the import/export process if they realize they have selected the wrong file or if they need to make changes before proceeding. Implementing a cancellation feature will enhance the user experience and provide more control over the import/export process. User should select the columns they want to export. This will allow users to customize their exports and reduce the size of the exported files by only including relevant data. We should also consider implementing a validation step before the import process begins to ensure that the data being imported meets the required format and standards. This will help prevent errors and ensure that the imported data is accurate and usable.
notes: Excel row limit fix done (WriteToExcelSheets multi-sheet split). Import price O(N²)→O(N) fixed. Import stock N+1→batch fixed. Remaining: date range filter, CSV format, column selection, progress indicator, cancel, validation.

description: For the category section we have a sync process that works with the marketplaces. User now can normally match a category with marketplace's category. But after doing this category attributes are supposed to be done seperately. This is a problem because user needs to do this process for every category and it is time consuming. We need to find a way to optimize this process and make it more efficient for the user. One possible solution could be to implement a bulk matching feature that allows users to match multiple categories at once. This could be done by allowing users to select multiple categories and then providing a mapping interface where they can match the selected categories with the corresponding marketplace categories in one go. Additionally, we could also consider implementing an auto-matching feature that uses machine learning algorithms or a simple LLM to automatically suggest matches based on the category names and attributes. This would further reduce the time and effort required for the matching process and improve the overall user experience. After matching the categories we need to redirect the user for those categories' attributes. This will allow users to complete the matching process in a more streamlined manner and ensure that all necessary information is captured for the categories. We should also consider implementing a validation step to ensure that the matched categories and their attributes are accurate and consistent with the marketplace's requirements. This will help prevent errors and ensure that the data is properly aligned with the marketplace's structure. User can do it for each marketplace. This will allow users to manage their category mappings for different marketplaces in a more organized and efficient way. We should also consider implementing a feature that allows users to save their category mappings as templates, which can be reused for similar categories in the future. This will further streamline the matching process and save time for users who frequently work with similar categories across different marketplaces.

task: In category matching there is only one attribute matching

We need to find a way to allow users to match multiple marketplace details for a single category. This will help ensure that all relevant information is captured for each category and improve the overall accuracy and completeness of the category matching process.

Once the user presses the brand matching button, they are redirected to a page where they can match their brands with the marketplace's brands. However, there is no user experience design for this page, and it can be confusing for users to navigate and complete the matching process. We need to design a user-friendly interface for the brand matching page that guides users through the process and makes it easy for them to match their brands with the marketplace's brands. This could include clear instructions, visual cues, and an intuitive layout that allows users to easily select and match their brands. Additionally, we should consider implementing features such as search functionality and filters to help users quickly find the relevant brands and streamline the matching process. For one brand, there can be multiple marketplace brands. We need to find a way to allow users to match multiple marketplace brands for a single brand. This will help ensure that all relevant information is captured for each brand and improve the overall accuracy and completeness of the brand matching process.
notes: SearchBrandsAsync (Trendyol API + DB fallback), BrandAutoMatchService (3-layer string match + Ollama), auto-match butonu + sonuç dialog, duplicate prevention chip'leri. 1467 test pass.

task: User management settings needs a UX
description: We had a user management page. unfortunetly I can not see it now. It may be because of the admin user hasn't got any permissions or we have deleted it from sidebar menu. We need to find a way to make it accessible for the admin user and design a user-friendly interface for the user management page that allows admins to easily manage users, assign roles and permissions, and perform other user-related tasks. This could include features such as search functionality, filters, and an intuitive layout that makes it easy for admins to navigate and complete their tasks efficiently.
notes: Root cause: AuthService.LoginAsync missing .ThenInclude(r => r.RoleClaims) — permissions were never loaded for non-Admin roles. Fixed login permission loading, RoleService AddRole/UpdateRole now saves permission claims. UX improvements: role column in user list, QuickFilter search, multi-role selection in UserEdit, active/passive toggle from list.

task: Permission restrictions for everything in the system
description: Users who do not have any permission for the page also they still can not see the menu item for that page. We need to implement permission restrictions for all pages and features in the system to ensure that users only have access to the functionalities that they are authorized to use. This will help improve security and prevent unauthorized access to sensitive information or critical features. We should also consider implementing a role-based access control system that allows us to easily manage permissions and assign them to different user roles based on their responsibilities and needs within the organization. But in the future we can sell them module by module maybe we might show them as passive options. This will allow users to see the available features and understand what they are missing out on, which could potentially encourage them to upgrade their permissions or purchase additional modules. However, we need to ensure that the passive options are clearly marked as unavailable and do not cause confusion for users who do not have access to those features. so in this case for specific roles we can show the menu items but they will be passive and when user clicks on them, we can show a pop-up that explains why they can not access that page and what they need to do to gain access. This will help improve the user experience and provide clear guidance for users who may be interested in accessing additional features or functionalities within the system. For other specific roles the menu items and the feature itself will not be visible. This will help ensure that users only see the options that are relevant to their role and prevent confusion or frustration for users who may be overwhelmed by too many options or features that they do not have access to.
notes: PermissionGuardedNavLink component (hidden/disabled/upgrade-popup modes). All ~35 NavMenu items protected with permission-based AuthorizeView. 48 page files got [Authorize(Policy=...)] attributes. UpgradePromptDialog for tenant feature upsell. AccessDenied fallback page. 8 new tests (bUnit + security).
manual_test_steps: Log in to the application with a user account that has limited permissions.
Navigate through the application and observe which menu items and features are visible and accessible.
Attempt to access a page or feature that the user does not have permission for and observe the behavior (e.g., whether the menu item is hidden, disabled, or shows a pop-up message).
Log in with a user account that has full permissions and verify that all menu items and features are visible and accessible.

Additionally, we should ensure that the notification system is reliable and delivers notifications in a timely manner to keep users informed about important updates and events within the system. Notifications can be sent to a single user, a group of users, or all users in the system. We should also consider implementing a notification history feature that allows users to view their past notifications and manage them as needed. This will help users keep track of their notifications and ensure that they do not miss any important information or updates.

task: Realtime chat system for users for our blazor system.
description: We should consider implementing a real-time chat system that allows users to communicate with each other within our Blazor system. This could be particularly useful for collaboration and support purposes, allowing users to easily ask questions, share information, and provide assistance to one another. The chat system should be designed to be user-friendly and intuitive, with features such as message notifications, typing indicators, and the ability to send attachments or links. Additionally, we should ensure that the chat system is secure and properly integrated with our existing blazor system. This will help enhance the overall user experience and foster a sense of community and collaboration among our users.
notes: Tam kapsamli realtime chat sistemi implement edildi. Entity: ChatConversation (Direct/Group), ChatMessage (Text/System/Link + reply), ChatParticipant (LastReadAt okunmamis takibi), ChatMessageReadReceipt. Business: ChatManager (7 metot, 3-adim pipeline), SendChatMessageDtoValidator. Altyapi: Ayri ChatHub (/ChatHub, typing indicator SignalR group), EventChannel + ChatEventPublisher + InProcessChatDeliveryService, UserOnlineStatusTracker. UI: /chat sayfasi (iki panel), ChatButton (AppBar unread badge), NewChatDialog, mesaj balonlari, cursor-based pagination. Migration: 4 tablo + indexler DB'ye uygulandı.
